summary: Horizon New Energy is CIP's manager-level Canadian platform and Aira Solar is an underlying Alberta project. The current Aira entities are CI V-named, the March 2025 amalgamation was internal, and the standalone CI IV-attributed Aira row should merge into Horizon while preserving project history.
